description: Individual taxation (Individualbesteuerung) and abolition of the 'marriage penalty' - described as her signature/heart project, pursued first via parliamentary motions and then via a popular initiative launched with the FDP Women.

Economically, socially and financially sustainable energy and environmental policy with an emphasis on security of supply; member of the National Council's Committee for the Environment, Spatial Planning and Energy (UREK-N) and co-president of the parliamentary cleantech group.
Liberal women's policy; long-time president of the FDP Women Switzerland and board member of alliance f; advocates against leaving women's policy to the political left.

Victim support, and protection of the elderly and people with disabilities, reflecting her work as ombudswoman and president of the victim support foundation; co-president of the parliamentary group on human trafficking.
Reading (preference for historical novels and crime fiction), cross-country skiing and biking in the Toggenburg region, and playing Jass with family and friends.
